activity.notes: Albert I succeeded Leopold II as King of the Belgians on 23 December 1909 and remained monarch until his death in a climbing accident at Marche-les-Dames on 17 February 1934. ATLAS uses the established Belgium polity and the generic ruler role King while preserving the constitutional title King of the Belgians in this note.

sources.title: King Albert I — The Belgian Monarchy
sources.citation_text: The official Belgian monarchy chronology records Albert's succession to Leopold II on 23 December 1909 and his death on 17 February 1934.
